name: set_flag_then_run_calls
description: Sets a status byte to one, then calls a fixed sequence of routines, passing an incrementing counter (0, 1, 2) to some of the calls. The callees are unnamed, so their purpose cannot be stated.

name: clear_work_area_set_defaults
description: Zeroes a 327-byte work area with a countdown loop, stores fixed default values into about fifteen state bytes, and writes an ascending run of ten values into a table. Two calls to unnamed routines are made before and after the stores.

name: reset_work_area_and_state
description: Repeats the same work-area zeroing and default-value stores as the neighbouring routine, with a one-instruction routine call added. The code matches the previous routine closely, so this is likely a duplicate copy of it.

name: run_when_counters_exceed_limits
description: Runs a block of calls only when two byte counters are both above fixed thresholds. Inside that block it picks one of two call sequences according to whether a flag byte is zero.

name: add_decimal_digits_with_carry
description: Adds two eight-digit decimal strings in place, working from the last digit backwards. Each digit sum above nine has ten subtracted and a carry passed to the next digit; a flag records a carry out of the top digit.

name: call_two_subroutines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns. The routine contains no logic of its own.

name: scan_table_and_run_handlers
description: Sets two status bytes, then scans a six-entry table for the first nonzero value while counting a counter upward. It calls a routine in a loop over a range of values, then clears the status bytes again.

name: clear_eight_byte_table
description: Writes zero to eight consecutive bytes of a fixed table, starting at its first entry.

name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Writes a supplied byte value to consecutive memory locations, advancing the pointer each time until the count reaches zero.

name: latch_flag_after_status_check
description: If a latch byte is clear, calls one routine and then checks a companion status byte. When that status byte is nonzero it sets the latch and calls a second routine.

name: set_latch_on_status_flag
description: Calls one routine, then sets a latch byte to one and calls another routine whenever a status byte is nonzero. This is the same test as the neighbouring routine without its guard on the latch.

name: subtract_decimal_strings_in_place
description: Subtracts one eight-byte packed decimal string from another in place, working from the last byte backwards with a borrow. Each underflowing digit has ten added back, and a flag records a borrow out of the top byte.

name: process_three_byte_records
description: Walks a list of three-byte records until it reaches an end marker, calling a routine for each record. Records whose top bit is set trigger an extra routine call.

name: scan_back_copy_text_block
description: Scans backwards through a text buffer for a high-bit terminator, looking at most thirty characters. It then sets the high bit on trailing space characters and copies a thirty-byte text block to the destination.

name: skip_terminated_entries_then_run
description: Sets a flag, then steps forward through a table of end-marked entries as many times as a count byte says, and finally calls a routine.

name: copy_three_byte_records
description: Copies records from a source list to a destination three bytes at a time, stopping at an end marker. For records with the top bit set it calls routines and stores a looked-up value as the third byte.

name: set_flag_from_argument
description: Calls some routines, then sets a flag byte to one when the argument is zero and clears it otherwise. The nonzero path also calls another routine.

name: select_mode_and_load_state
description: Chooses a state setup from a mode byte. Mode one copies a twenty-byte default block into the state, mode two copies saved fields back, and other values derive a shift count; sign bits then decide how several state bytes are reassigned.

name: busy_wait_delay_loop
description: Counts a 16-bit register down until it wraps past zero, spinning without other work. The loop is a simple timing delay.

name: conditionally_call_middle_routine
description: Calls one routine, calls a second routine only when a status byte is not one, and then calls a third routine.

name: call_routine_per_high_byte
description: Calls a routine repeatedly while stepping a 16-bit counter down by 256 on each pass, so the number of calls equals the counter's high byte.

name: call_three_subroutines
description: Calls three unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other logic.

name: call_one_subroutine
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no other logic.

name: call_three_routines_after_setup
description: Loads a small constant through an unnamed routine, then calls three unnamed routines in sequence. It is close to the three-call routine before it.

name: dispatch_by_state_value
description: Calls routines and, unless the state byte is one, two or three, calls one more routine. It then stores three into a status byte and calls a final routine.

name: branch_on_mode_flag
description: If a mode flag is zero it makes two routine calls and returns. Otherwise it picks one of two routine calls according to a second flag, then makes a final call.

name: mark_flag_on_zero_argument
description: Calls two routines, then sets a status byte to one when the argument is zero. The nonzero path skips that store.

name: copy_blocks_when_enabled
description: When an enable byte is set, copies a 300-byte block to one destination and then a block of about 3,200 bytes to a second destination. Routines are called before and after the copies.

name: select_slot_from_position_value
description: Picks one of five slots from the range a position byte falls in, returning early if that slot is already taken. It records the chosen slot, copies a two-byte source into two state fields, then calls routines to finish the setup.

name: increment_position_up_to_ten
description: Increments a position byte up to ten times, stopping early if it reaches the all-ones value.

name: decrement_position_down_to_one
description: Decrements a position byte up to ten times, stopping early when it reaches one.

name: increment_offset_up_to_ten
description: Increments an offset byte up to ten times, stopping early if it reaches the all-ones value. It does the same work as the position increment routine on a different byte.

name: increment_level_capped_at_fifteen
description: Adds one to a level byte unless it has already reached fifteen.

name: decrement_level_if_positive
description: Subtracts one from a level byte unless it is already zero.

name: run_repeated_step_until_flag
description: Repeatedly calls routines and a timing routine in a loop that counts down from six. It leaves early when any of several status bytes is set or when a condition byte is clear.

name: run_paired_routine_sequence
description: Calls an unnamed routine twice, with groups of unnamed routine calls between and after them. The unnamed-routine calls are interleaved with the other calls in one fixed order.

name: call_seven_subroutines
description: Calls seven unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other logic.

name: run_paired_routine_calls
description: Calls an unnamed routine twice with a sequence of unnamed routine calls around them. It is the same body as the sequence routine before it.

name: stub_routine_pair_entry
description: The executable holds only three instructions here, which look like a jump stub. The decompiled body repeats the routine-pair sequence of the neighbouring routines, so the decompilation is not a reliable description of this entry.

name: run_routine_pair_calls
description: Calls an unnamed routine twice, with a fixed sequence of unnamed routine calls around the unnamed-routine calls. It matches the routine-pair sequence routines before it.

name: finish_countdown_and_signal
description: While a flag is set, counts a byte down once per call. When it reaches zero, it makes several routine calls, clears one status byte and sets another.

name: shift_value_set_low_bit
description: Shifts a byte one bit to the right, sets its lowest bit, and stores the result back in place.

name: tick_four_bit_timer
description: When no blocking flags are set and a state byte is nonzero, steps a four-bit counter down. It reloads the counter at twelve when it reaches zero and makes calls at particular counter values.

name: initialise_state_and_poll_loop
description: Sets initial values for several state bytes, then loops while polling a status byte against a fixed bit pattern. Inside the loop it copies small blocks into working areas, makes calls and decrements a counter until it breaks out.

name: copy_table_row_by_index
description: Advances a source pointer by thirty bytes for each step of a counter, then copies a thirty-byte row from that point into a fixed destination.

name: copy_secondary_state_and_call
description: Calls routines, copies a secondary state byte into the primary state byte, then calls another routine.

name: copy_three_triplets_and_sync
description: Copies three groups of three bytes between fixed locations, then copies a secondary state byte into the primary one and calls a routine.

name: set_cell_from_index_table
description: Sets a byte to one of two constants depending on a flag, writes a table-selected value into a computed location, and calls routines in a loop that runs twelve minus an index times.

name: copy_seven_bytes_with_lookup
description: Copies a seven-byte block between two fixed areas, copies it back when a flag is clear, then stores two bytes read from a lookup table indexed by a state value.

name: delay_loop_by_counter
description: Counts a byte down to zero with an empty loop body, so the routine only spends time.

name: delay_loop_with_hidden_call
description: Counts a byte down to zero in an empty loop body. The facts list one unnamed call that the decompiled body does not show, so the loop may hide that call.

name: poll_cia_port_for_button
description: Polls a byte read from the CIA port A register until bit six is set, then until bit seven is set with the byte otherwise zero. It then sets two status flags and calls routines.

name: call_nine_times_clear_flag
description: If a pending flag is set, calls one routine nine times and then clears the flag.

name: setup_and_run_sequence_loop
description: Copies two seven-byte blocks into the work area and sets several counters and status bytes. When no blocking flags are set it runs a loop of calls that stops when a countdown byte reaches zero or a condition byte changes.

name: repeat_call_count_times
description: Calls a routine in a loop, counting down from a register value until it reaches zero.

name: call_pair_of_subroutines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other logic. It matches the earlier two-call routine.

name: run_two_counted_passes
description: Clears a status byte, then runs one counted pass of routine calls with a first address and another counted pass with a second address, toggling a flag between them. It sets the status byte at the end.

name: advance_table_step_and_copy
description: When no blocking flags are set, advances a step counter that wraps at seven and compares two stored bytes with a table entry to move an index on. At one step it copies four three-byte entries into a work area, and it sets a completion flag when the index reaches its end.

name: score_and_record_table_entry
description: Computes a value from two counter bytes, stores that value plus one in the next table entry and advances the table index. A nonzero value sets a flag and calls routines, and a range check then sets one of several flag bytes.

name: skip_sixteen_strings_and_mark
description: Steps past sixteen end-marked strings in a table, writes a marker byte after them, and sets a copy counter from a source byte. It then advances a counter and returns.

name: spin_count_down_register
description: Counts a register down to zero in a loop with no body, so the routine only spends time.

name: start_level_countdown_sequence
description: Sets two flags and copies per-level values from a table into state bytes. If no blocking flags are set it runs a counted sequence of calls that ends early when a blocking flag appears, then sets a final mode byte.

name: dispatch_on_status_bits
description: When a flag is set and a pair of position bytes is nonzero, it tests bits in a status byte and calls routines for the bits that are clear. It returns after the middle check.

name: set_bit_one_around_call
description: Sets bit one of a status byte, clears a state byte, calls routines, then restores the saved state byte and calls one more routine.

name: set_bit_two_around_call
description: Sets bit two of a status byte, clears a state byte, calls routines, then restores the saved state byte and calls one more routine.

name: set_bit_four_around_calls
description: Sets bit four of a status byte, makes routine calls, then restores a saved state byte and calls one more routine.

name: initialise_state_block_and_calls
description: Clears a mode byte and sets two counters. It calls a routine for each index from thirteen to twenty-two with a rising value, copies a base byte into a state byte and sets a flag.

name: accumulate_indexed_byte
description: Adds a byte fetched from a table at an index to a running total byte.

name: set_bit_eight_once
description: When a flag is set and bit eight of a status byte is clear, sets that bit, calls routines and clears two state bytes.

name: set_flag_between_calls
description: Calls a routine, sets a status byte to one, then calls another routine.

name: update_entry_by_level_range
description: Copies a shared byte into two state bytes and returns early when the argument is above eight. Otherwise it picks one of two branches by range, writes computed values into table entries and decrements a counter.

name: increment_nonzero_table_entries
description: Adds one to each of three table bytes that are neither zero nor the all-ones value.

name: decrement_nonzero_table_entries
description: Subtracts one from each of three table bytes that are neither zero nor the all-ones value.

name: find_minimum_unflagged_index
description: Scans four entries and records the smallest value whose matching status byte has its top bit clear. The index of that entry is stored in a result byte.

name: skip_counted_strings_and_flag
description: Sets a flag byte to one, steps past a count of end-marked strings in a table, then calls a routine.

name: fill_entries_copy_nine_bytes
description: Calls routines for thirty entries, advancing an address by twenty and a value by three on each step. It then runs a counted delay and copies two nine-byte blocks between fixed areas.

name: copy_two_nine_byte_blocks
description: Copies nine bytes from a source table to a destination, then copies nine bytes from the end of that source into a second destination.

name: clear_and_call_per_count
description: Clears a byte, then loops over a count and calls routines on each step. It stores the count in a state byte, makes a call with a lookup-table value and finishes with a final routine call.

name: call_one_routine_only
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns. It matches the one-call routine before it.

name: copy_bytes_backward_by_flag
description: When the argument is not one, copies two backward-running byte runs between fixed areas. The source area depends on a flag byte, so the copy follows one of two source blocks.

name: advance_timer_records_with_index
description: Steps through thirty five-byte records, decrementing each record's first byte and reloading it from another byte when it reaches zero. A shared six-step index selects a value from a table, and records with the top bit set take a different path.

name: store_indexed_pointer_entry
description: When a flag is clear, stores a five-bit value from a shared byte into a table entry chosen by an index. It derives two pointers by stepping through fixed row sizes and calls routines with them.

name: run_flag_dependent_calls
description: When a status byte is nonzero, makes several routine calls, adding one more when bit six is set and another when bit seven is set, then restores a saved byte. When the status byte is zero it calls two routines.

name: initialise_thirty_entry_table
description: Sets a mode flag and two counters, then calls a routine for each of thirty table entries with a pointer that advances by five. It copies nine bytes between tables chosen by the mode and clears the mode flag.

name: rebuild_thirty_entry_table
description: Repeats the thirty-entry table pass of the routine before it, without setting the mode flag first. It copies nine bytes between the same tables and clears the mode flag.

name: insert_into_ranked_table
description: Scans ten table entries for the first one larger than an argument. It stores the argument there, records a second byte ten places later and calls a routine. If no entry is larger it returns without change.

name: process_entries_with_marker
description: Loops over a count and toggles a shared bit on each pass, calling routines for each entry with an offset. A marker value of -2 selects a separate path that makes extra calls and restores a saved value.

name: select_pointer_by_argument
description: Sets two state bytes, then either makes three calls with the same argument when it equals a fixed code, or steps a pointer down by a fixed amount for each unit above a base. It makes a final call in both cases.

name: select_constant_by_code
description: Chooses one of three constants according to an argument code, sets two state bytes and calls routines with the chosen constant and the second argument.

name: copy_four_bytes_after_setup
description: Sets a counter and a flag, makes calls chosen by a condition byte, and copies four bytes between fixed areas. It then sets the counter and the flag again and calls a routine.

name: clamp_flagged_byte_to_eight
description: Calls routines with a byte from the argument, and when that byte has its top bit set it calls another routine and stores eight in its place. Two alternative paths check different status bytes.

name: count_down_with_hidden_calls
description: Counts a register down to zero in a loop whose decompiled body is empty. The facts list three unnamed calls that the decompilation does not show, so the loop may hide them.

name: spin_count_down_register_alt
description: Counts a register down to zero with an empty loop body, so the routine only spends time.

name: find_matching_table_slot
description: Searches two small tables for the entry that matches a state byte, falling back to the first larger entry, and stores the slot numbers found. It then sets two state bytes and makes routine calls.

name: adjust_position_from_threshold
description: Adjusts position and count bytes in either of two modes. Thresholds on a counter choose a step of two, four or six, and a marker value is written into a table entry chosen by the position.

name: store_fixed_word_value
description: Writes the constant 1024 to a fixed 16-bit word in memory and returns.

name: call_six_subroutines
description: Calls six unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other logic.

name: wait_for_beam_position_zero
description: Spins on the vertical beam position register until its low byte reads zero, synchronising the routine to the video beam.

name: fade_colour_table_steps
description: Copies sixteen colour-register pairs into a buffer. It then makes fifteen passes that subtract one step from two colour-component fields of each entry, leaving zero unchanged, and copies the buffer back after each pass.

name: clear_large_memory_block
description: Calls a routine, then zeroes 2000 groups of four 32-bit words, starting at a fixed address.

name: zero_four_word_groups
description: Zeroes 2000 groups of four 32-bit words starting at a fixed address, with no other work. It repeats the clearing loop of the routine before it, without the call.

name: fill_four_plane_words_pattern
description: Writes all-ones words to three arrays and zeroes a fourth, with 4000 words in each array spaced 8000 bytes apart. The layout matches a four-plane graphics buffer.

name: fill_four_plane_words_alt
description: Writes zero, all-ones, zero and zero to four arrays of 4000 words spaced 8000 bytes apart. It is a second fill pattern over the same four-plane layout as the routine before it.

name: return_register_pair
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then returns the values of two 32-bit input registers together as a single 64-bit result.

name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns a constant zero as its result.

name: mask_high_byte_of_word
description: Returns the high byte of a 16-bit input value, with the low byte cleared.

name: mask_high_byte_alt
description: Returns the same result as the high-byte routine before it. The decompiled body is identical, so this is probably a second copy of that routine.

name: unpack_four_plane_cells
description: Reads a width and height from a header, then copies each four-byte cell into four separate plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart. It calls a routine for each cell.

name: copy_four_plane_cells
description: Copies four-byte cells into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart, using width and height counters already held in state. It calls a routine for each cell.

name: blend_masked_plane_cells
description: Reads a width and height from a header, then merges each four-byte cell into the four plane arrays under a mask. The planes are cleared where the mask is set and filled from the cell bits, which is a masked merge of image data.

name: merge_masked_plane_cells
description: Merges four-byte cells into four plane arrays under a mask, using width and height counters from state instead of a header. It is the same masked merge as the routine before it.

name: countdown_then_set_counters
description: Calls a routine when a flag is set, then counts an offset down to the all-ones value. It sets two counter bytes depending on the flag and calls a routine.

name: write_masked_plane_bits
description: Walks a grid of counter-controlled cells and writes a source byte into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart. A flag selects whether the planes are set from the byte or cleared under its inverse.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction. The facts list a hardware timer register, but the body never touches it, so this is an empty stub.

name: fill_column_pattern_by_mode
description: Fills eight rows of four plane arrays with one of four bit patterns chosen by two mode bytes, advancing the pointer forty bytes per row.

name: setup_keyboard_interrupt_registers
description: Works with the CIA-A control, interrupt and serial registers and the interrupt enable and request registers, which points to keyboard handling setup. The decompiled body shows only a five-pass call loop, so the register work is not visible here.

name: read_joystick_direction_code
description: Polls the CIA port A byte and the two joystick movement registers, waiting on a button-related bit. It then sets a result code from zero to three that encodes the stick direction read from the movement bits.

name: wait_until_result_one
description: Calls routines repeatedly until a result byte equals one, then resets that byte to zero.

name: update_counter_on_result_change
description: Acts on a result code: returns early for the first two codes, takes an update path for the next one and otherwise resets the code. When a related value differs it adjusts a counter up or down and calls routines.

name: copy_column_across_plane_rows
description: Computes a starting value from two table bytes, then for each row calls a routine and copies an eight-step column of bytes with a forty-byte stride. Each copied byte is also written 8000 bytes further on in the plane array.

name: copy_plane_column_rows
description: For each row, calls a routine and copies an eight-step column of bytes from the third plane array into the second, advancing forty bytes per step.

name: write_header_from_value
description: Stores three bytes derived from a global value and a zero marker at the start of a buffer, then copies fifteen 32-bit words from a source into the buffer.

name: copy_sixteen_long_table
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed table into the same buffer used by the header routine.

name: cycle_sequence_down_by_seventeen
description: Steps a byte down from a fixed start value in steps of seventeen, making routine calls on each step, until it reaches seventeen. It then stores thirty-four in that byte.

name: cycle_sequence_up_by_seventeen
description: Steps a byte up from a fixed start value in steps of seventeen, making routine calls on each step, until it reaches a fixed end value. It then stores another fixed value in that byte.

name: unpack_sixteen_byte_pairs
description: Copies sixteen two-byte pairs from a fixed source into a buffer, placing each pair on a four-byte stride.

name: spread_pairs_in_place
description: Spreads sixteen two-byte pairs across a four-byte stride within the same buffer, reading the pairs from the start of the buffer.

name: spread_pairs_in_place_alt
description: Repeats the in-place pair spreading of the routine before it.

name: spread_pairs_in_place_repeat
description: Repeats the in-place pair spreading of the earlier routines. The body is the same, so it is probably a duplicate copy.

name: call_five_subroutines
description: Calls five unnamed routines in sequence and returns. The routine is also referenced by address, so it may be reached through a table.

name: call_five_subroutines_direct
description: Calls five unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other logic.

name: iterate_table_pairs_when_enabled
description: When two state bytes are both nonzero, loops over a table of four-byte entries. It reads one byte from each entry and calls routines for every entry.

name: call_one_routine_wrapper
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns.

name: set_flag_one_then_call
description: Sets a status byte to one and calls one unnamed routine.

name: clear_flag_then_call
description: Sets a status byte to zero and calls one unnamed routine.

name: call_routines_with_pair_calls
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then two unnamed routines, then three more unnamed routines, and returns.

name: call_three_routine_sequence
description: Calls three unnamed routines in sequence and returns.

name: clear_bits_in_plane_rows
description: Walks a table of row bytes until it reaches a zero entry. For each nonzero row it clears one rotating bit across four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart, calling a routine for each cell.

name: wait_byte_change_then_reset
description: Makes routine calls, then repeats a loop while a saved byte equals a fixed value. It then stores another fixed value in a status byte, clears a flag and makes a series of routine calls.

name: decrement_byte_if_nonzero
description: Subtracts one from a status byte unless it is already zero.

name: wrap_call_with_flag_set
description: Calls routines with an argument, setting a status byte to one around one of the calls and clearing it afterwards.

name: call_block_with_flag_window
description: Makes several routine calls, setting a status byte to one around one of them and clearing it afterwards.

name: finish_flagged_sequence_branch
description: Makes calls with a flag set around one of them, then branches on a byte to choose a follow-up call. It copies a secondary value into a state byte, clears two status bytes and calls a routine.

name: finish_flagged_sequence_long
description: Repeats the flagged call sequence of the routine before it, with more routine calls around it.

name: walk_grid_calling_routine
description: Sets a flag around a grid walk that calls a routine for each cell, stepping along rows and columns by fixed increments.

name: set_flag_around_call
description: Sets a status byte to one, calls one unnamed routine, then clears the status byte.

name: call_pairs_until_end_marker
description: Steps past a count of end-marked strings in a table, then calls two routines for each two-byte entry until it reaches an end marker.

name: select_table_slot_and_count
description: Finds the first slot whose flag byte has its top bit clear, runs a counted loop from a table value at that slot, and sets two status bytes to fixed values.

name: select_table_slot_only
description: Finds the first slot whose flag byte has its top bit clear, runs a counted loop from a table value at that slot, and sets two status bytes.

name: call_routine_stepping_five
description: Makes a series of routine calls for each step of a count, passing a value that rises by five each time, and records an index byte.

name: emit_countdown_values_by_slot
description: When enabled, loops a count of times calling a routine with a value that depends on the state. The value drops by a step size on each pass, and each pass also makes a routine call.

name: repeat_pair_calls_by_count
description: Calls two routines in a loop, counting the second argument down to zero.

name: call_routine_stepping_seven
description: Makes a series of calls where the argument rises by seven each pass, for a count held in a register.

name: run_flagged_call_sequence_fixed
description: Sets status flags around a sequence of calls, passing a fixed value and a state byte to routines. A branch makes extra calls when a second byte is nonzero.

name: process_input_characters
description: Reads character codes and stores a table byte for each code in a fixed range. The delete code steps back one entry, the carriage-return code ends the routine, and the escape code breaks out of the loop.

name: fill_text_buffer_with_spaces
description: Fills thirty bytes of a text buffer with the space character and writes an end marker after them.

name: check_threshold_and_reset_state
description: When a state byte is clear and a counter exceeds a threshold, calls a routine. Otherwise, when a second flag is clear, it makes several calls, sets a value and clears a state byte.

name: trigger_once_above_threshold
description: When a flag is clear, another flag is set and a counter is above 199, sets the flag and runs routines with fixed arguments. It then sets a value and makes final calls.

name: set_status_flag_one
description: Sets a status byte to one and returns.

name: clear_status_flag_zero
description: Sets a status byte to zero and returns.

name: bounded_poll_after_init_calls
description: Makes four routine calls, then polls a flag inside a loop of at most sixty calls. It clears a byte the pointer refers to when the wait ends.

name: bounded_poll_then_clear_byte
description: Polls a flag inside a loop of at most sixty calls, then clears a byte the pointer refers to. It is the same wait as the routine before it, without the leading calls.

name: call_routine_ten_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine ten times in a row.

name: mark_entry_match_status
description: Compares a table entry with the same index in a second table. It writes forty-two when they match, forty-three when the value appears earlier in the table, and sixty otherwise, into the indexed slot.

name: advance_index_until_table_value
description: Stores a byte, calls a routine, then advances a six-bit index that wraps at sixty-four. The index keeps advancing while it is below the table entry it points to.

name: advance_index_without_call
description: Advances a six-bit index the same way as the routine before it, but without the leading call.

name: layout_text_into_lines
description: Scans a text buffer and counts characters up to a line width. At each space it records a line-break position and writes the lines to the output, stopping at an all-ones byte.

name: walk_grid_rows_calling_routine
description: When a flag is clear, walks a grid row by row and calls a routine for each cell between a start and an end column. It stops when the rows are exhausted.

name: walk_grid_rows_unconditionally
description: Walks a grid row by row and calls a routine for each cell between a start and an end column. It does not check a flag first.

name: skip_all_ones_terminated_strings
description: Advances a pointer past a count of strings, where each string ends with the all-ones byte.

name: skip_high_bit_terminated_entries
description: Advances a pointer past a count of entries, where each entry ends at a byte with its top bit set.

name: call_within_status_window
description: Sets one status byte to one and a second to zero around a routine call, restores them, and then makes two more calls.

name: interpret_command_bytes
description: Reads command bytes from a buffer until it reaches an all-ones byte. The flag bits of each command select one of several actions, including lookups in fixed tables and routine calls.

name: format_digits_and_punctuation
description: Converts small values into ASCII digit characters by adding forty-eight. It copies a few punctuation codes while skipping a space that precedes them, and ends the buffer with an all-ones byte.

name: find_entry_high_byte
description: Steps through four-byte table entries until a count is used up or an all-ones entry is reached. It returns the third byte of the entry, shifted into the high byte of a 16-bit result.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does nothing. Nine routines call it as a no-op.

name: set_bounds_from_arguments
description: Stores two argument-derived bounds in state words, one incremented and one decremented, then makes routine calls. It zeroes a counter and clears a status byte only when a second status byte is clear.

name: clear_plane_bits_over_grid
description: Clears the top bit across a grid of four plane arrays, then clears the lowest bit across a second range of columns. It zeroes a set of bytes with calls between the passes. The code shows no executable-loading logic, despite a hint suggesting it.

name: run_position_update_loop
description: Computes a few position values from a stored byte, then runs a loop of routine calls that stops when a flag changes. Each pass checks the low three bits of a position value and calls routines when they are zero or seven.

name: count_down_mode_then_call
description: Makes a call only for mode values four and two, then counts a copy of the mode value down to zero and makes a final call.

name: call_three_routines_b
description: Calls three unnamed routines in sequence and returns.

name: count_down_mode_empty_loop
description: Counts a mode byte down to one with an empty loop body, so the routine only spends time.

name: dispatch_on_mode_value
description: When a flag is set, makes one routine call for mode values one and two and another for other values. A mode value of four makes one more call.

name: copy_four_plane_words_fixed
description: Copies 960 groups of four words from a fixed source into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart, writing one word of each group to each plane.

name: copy_plane_words_from_pointer
description: Copies groups of four words from a source pointer into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart. The count comes from a register, so the amount copied varies.

name: copy_plane_block_from_source
description: Copies a block of 1920 words into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart, from a fixed source into a buffer addressed through a stored pointer.

name: copy_plane_block_small
description: Copies a block of 320 words into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart. It uses the same layout as the routine before it with a smaller count.

name: call_six_routines_sequence
description: Calls six unnamed routines in sequence and returns.

name: call_for_flagged_table_bytes
description: Sets two counter bytes, then steps through a table of four-byte groups. It calls a routine for each entry equal to one and stops at the first entry that is not one.

name: copy_plane_block_medium
description: Copies a block of 1120 words into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart, from a fixed source into a buffer addressed by a stored offset.

name: copy_plane_block_to_pointer
description: Copies 960 words from a fixed source into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart, starting at a buffer pointer kept in memory.

name: copy_plane_block_full
description: Copies 4000 words from a fixed source into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart, starting at a buffer pointer kept in memory.

name: wrap_calls_with_status_flag
description: Sets a status byte to one around a set of routine calls, including an unnamed routine, then clears the byte.

name: unpack_run_length_stream
description: Expands a run-length stream into a fixed buffer: a positive count copies that many bytes, while a negative count repeats the next byte. A marker value of minus 128 is skipped. It then rearranges the buffer into four plane arrays, two hundred rows of twenty words each.

name: pack_buffer_into_plane_rows
description: Copies two hundred rows of twenty words from a fixed buffer into four plane arrays spaced 8000 bytes apart. It is the same copy as the second half of the routine before it.

name: stub_infinite_loop
description: Contains an empty endless loop, so the routine never returns. It acts as a halt or trap.

name: run_state_table_dispatch
description: Copies thirty-two bytes backwards into a buffer, then loops over a table of step codes at a counter-indexed position. Codes one to four trigger routine calls, and the loop exits when a status value is set.

name: run_state_table_dispatch_alt
description: Repeats the table dispatch of the routine before it. The decompiled body is identical.

name: run_state_table_dispatch_copy
description: Repeats the table dispatch of the earlier routines. The decompiled body is identical to them.

name: stub_state_table_dispatch
description: Shows the same decompiled body as the three routines before it, but the executable holds only one instruction here. The decompiled code is therefore not a reliable description of this entry.
